about_the_game:
Acornia Of The Stars is a retro 3D platformer where you play as Auri a fearless incompetent acorn in search of a new home for his people after his home planet has been destroyed. You must sprint, jump and homing attack your way through the different worlds that you encounter along the way.

Auri and the Acorn folks’ home planet is destroyed in a catastrophic asteroid strike. This strike sends a small chunk of their home world into orbit around the center of the universe, however this chunk is slowly dying so the Acorn folk must try and discover a new world to call home. Auri is the only one brave enough to explore the universe looking for a new planet. They have heard the outer rim is the best option, however they don't have enough power to reach it yet.

Even worse an evil tyrant named the Gatekeeper blocks anyone who ever tries to cross into the outer rim.

They must collect enough of the Acorn folk in each nearby planet in order to get the acorn power they need to reach the outer edges of the solar system are you up for the task of saving Acorn kind?
